name: - SEAMAN
fix_description: Remove the cross-pair swap logic in swapAndLiquifyV3/V1 that converts SEAMAN to external tokens (GVC/lpToken) affecting the BUSD-GVC pair. Token transfer should not have side effects on unrelated trading pairs. If fee distribution is needed, keep it within the SEAMAN pair only.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a short multi-step price-manipulation attack using a flash loan, token swaps, and repeated transfers to a pair to corrupt token/pair accounting before dumping back to USDT. It is not deeply complex, but it does require understanding fee-on-transfer/tokenomics behavior and AMM pair interaction beyond a trivial access-control bug.
